services.shortdesc: Let me mend and alter your favourite clothes so that they can work for you. Check out my price list, come visit me at a happy hour, or get in touch to get all your questions answered.
services.longdesc: I firmly believe that our clothes should work for us and that we shouldn't have to change our bodies to fit our clothes.  Clothes that fit our bodies and our personal style and make us happy are also more sustainable, because we reach for them over and over again, instead of buying new clothes.  I can hem your jeans, take in your dresses and replace the linings in your jackets, but if you would like to customise your clothes, I can work with you on that too!

services.shortdesc: I've made my own clothes for over a decade, now it's time for me to make clothes for you! Whether it's a special occasion or just some everyday staples, the clothes I make for you will look great, are washable, and most of all, will fit you! Come talk to me, let's make fashion!
services.longdesc: Whether you have a special occassion coming up, or would like a couple of nice shirts to wear to the office during the week, I can custom make clothes to fit you and your style!  My speciality is mid-century women's clothes -- think 1940's through to the early 1970's, complete with handmade touches -- but once you go custom, truly anything is possible!  First we would meet for a consultation and agree on what needs to be made, a deposit is paid, then a toile, or a prototype is made, a practice garment where the fit is perfected.  From there, you can source the fabric needed yourself, or I can find it for you before starting on the final product.  The balance is paid when the garment is delivered to you.

services.shortdesc: In the style of our parents' tupperware parties, get your crew together and we'll fix some things! I'll demo some basic fixes (and, of course, tailor your clothes).  Learn more!
services.longdesc: Like a tupperware party but without the MLM nonsense!  Book a meeting room and invite your team to bring their work clothes that need alterations, or set up some wine and cheese and tell your friends to bring their clothes that need fixing.  I will come and demonstrate some sewing skills for you (and any other crafty thing you'd like to see!) and take everyone's clothes away for service before returning them back to the host a week later.

services.shortdesc: Are you crafty yourself but want to skip the boring stuff? I can finish and block your knitted and crochet garments and wind your skeins of yarn.
services.longdesc: You are so close to finishing your new sweater but ugh!  All those ends to weave in, the sleeves need to be seamed, and it needs to be blocked (and you know your cat is going to sit on it while that happens).  I can help!  I have all the tools and know-how to complete those pesky little jobs and can then deliver you back a beautifully finished piece of work.  You still even get to take the credit!

services.shortdesc: Do you need a hand confronting your sewing machine?  I provide inexpensive cleanings and servicing then I'll show you how to make the most out of your machine.
services.longdesc: Do you have a sewing machine but are a little nervous if it works or not?  Maybe you acquired a family memeber's machine, but it needs a little TLC?  I can come assess the machine, test to see if it works, clean it up, oil it, everything you need to get started.  I will also walk you through how to make the most of your machine and maintain it.  And if the machine requires more attention than that, I will be upfront about that and refer you to a specialised technician.

services.shortdesc: I sew, knit and crochet, let's make your next trunk show or sewing pattern look good! Contact me directly to get started.
services.longdesc: I have done sample knitting for companies like Wool and Co where I deliver timely projects based on your specific needs and requirements.  I can also test any new patterns you have and provide you with detailed feedback based on my decades plus experience as a seamstress.
